comparison.objective: Make a hot soldering iron safe in its holder before placing a circuit board on the mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Hazard-aware handling of a tethered tool and precise insertion into an angled holder.
comparison.success_condition: Iron is safely housed, board is placed, prohibited hot-part contacts are avoided, and hands are clear.
comparison.reason: The mechanical operation is tethered-tool stowage, not adjustable-stop calibration or lock retention.
